answers.product: Schottky/TVS diodes, Cortex-M7 dev boards and ESP32-based IoT modules

advisor-profile.stage: 85 staff, Osaka. ¥2.4B revenue; exports to ASEAN and Europe (~30% of sales); no India presence yet
advisor-profile.products: 1) Schottky and TVS diodes for power and ESD protection in EV chargers, inverters and consumer electronics. 2) Cortex-M7 development boards (Teensy-class, 600 MHz) for prototyping and small-batch industrial controllers. 3) ESP32-based Wi-Fi/Bluetooth IoT modules for smart meters, appliances and factory sensors
advisor-profile.usp: Diodes: AEC-Q101 automotive-qualified, failure rate <1 ppm, ~15% lower forward voltage. Boards/modules: industrial temperature range (−40 to 85 °C), 3-year supply guarantee, Japanese QC on every batch
advisor-profile.price: Diodes ¥4–18 each (10k+); M7 board ¥4,800; ESP32 module ¥650–1,200 (1k+) — Japan list
advisor-profile.customers: Japanese tier-1 auto suppliers and appliance makers; EMS firms in Vietnam and Thailand; distributors in Germany
advisor-profile.buyerType: EMS / contract manufacturers (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Noida), EV-charger and EV two-wheeler makers, smart-meter and IoT device makers
advisor-profile.investment: ₹1.5 crore (≈ ¥25M) over the first 2 years, including a pilot and certification
advisor-profile.modify: Yes: packaging, labelling, firmware defaults; no change to the diode process
advisor-profile.capacity: Diodes 40M units/month (MOQ 10k per part); boards 20k/month (MOQ 500); modules 60k/month (MOQ 1k)
advisor-profile.ip: Diode process patents in Japan only; exclusive distributor in Vietnam; open to a non-exclusive Indian distributor first
advisor-profile.contacts: None. Two Indian EMS firms requested quotes via our website last year
advisor-profile.timeline: First paid order within 9 months; low risk tolerance: distributor before any entity
advisor-profile.notes: Wireless modules may need WPC/ETA approval; check BIS registration; India's electronics PLI push is a demand signal

coach-form.message: Thank you for your request. Unfortunately it is difficult for us to reduce the price at this time. We will consider your proposal internally and contact you again.

negotiate-form.product: ESP32 IoT modules and power diodes
negotiate-form.terms: Distributor margin, Minimum order, Payment terms
negotiate-form.position: Margin up to 15%; MOQ 1k modules; no credit on the first order, 30 days after
